messages:
morgan: Hey folks — after the canary cutover at ~16:03 UTC the latency dashboard for `frontend-api` lost the p95/p99 lines. p50/p90 still show up. Screenshot: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T12345-F1234567890/latency-missing.png

samir: I saw that too. Looks like the quantile series are gone entirely, not just graph rendering. Did something change in metrics shape?

deploy-bot: Canary cutover completed: release/2026-03-16 @ 16:02:13 UTC. No rollout errors reported. https://deploys.redwood/release/2026-03-16

anya: @monitoring-bot can you run the aggregation checks? Maybe we switched from histogram to summary accidentally.

monitoring-bot: Query check: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))` -> returns 0 series for `route=frontend-api` after 16:03 UTC. Pre-16:03 returned values.

nate: Quick repro locally: `kubectl exec -n infra metrics-collector -- curl -s "http://localhost:9090/api/v1/query?query=histogram_quantile(0.99,%20sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]))%20by%20(le,route))"` -> 0 series. Also inspected `/metrics` on new frontend pod and I see `http_request_duration_seconds{quantile="0.5"}` (summary) instead of `_bucket` metrics.

olivia-support: Got a customer ping (ticket #4572) about p99 spikes not showing. I replied that we're investigating — will update them.

morgan: That matches my hunch — the new metrics SDK flips to summaries. Dashboards use `histogram_quantile(...)` and depend on `_bucket`. We need short-term dashboard fallback and long-term fix in the release.

samir: Short-term plan: add dashboard fallback to try `histogram_quantile(...)` and if empty fall back to `http_request_duration_seconds{quantile="0.95"}`. Also tweak alert queries to detect missing histogram series.

anya: I'll draft the dashboard PR and an alerts patch. Also proposing a release-gate: metric-type changes require a spec + SRE+owner signoff.

nate: Rollback would restore histograms, but also remove the new SDK. I prefer adapting dashboards first to avoid churn.

morgan: Agreed. Do the dashboard patch, update alerts, then decide if SDK change should be rolled back. Olivia — can you update customers with an ETA?

olivia-support: Yep. I'll send a customer update and post to #support. ETA ~1 hour for the fallback to be live. :thumbsup:

samir: Pushing a temporary dashboard patch now, will post link once merged.

monitoring-bot: Patch merged to staging dashboards. Cache refresh scheduled; waiting ~5m.

morgan: Confirmed on staging: p95/p99 lines reappear via summary fallback. Open follow-ups: 1) migration plan for metrics SDK change; 2) release note clarifying metrics shape; 3) add gating for metric-type changes.

deploy-bot: Note: feature flag `use-new-metrics-sdk` enabled in canary at 16:02:13 UTC.

anya: Filing a short postmortem with repro steps and links: https://git.redwood/metrics/compare/old..new — will include dashboard diff and alert updates.

nate: Updated ticket #4572 with resolution steps and ETA.

morgan: Thanks everyone — marking this as resolved for the incident but keeping the postmortem open for action items.
